# MindsHub

> MindsHub is the platform for open-source AI agents — where they live, learn,
> and get things done. Delegate tasks through Cowork, the unified workspace,
> or run any agent with its native harness.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://mindshub.ai/): the platform for open-source AI agents — delegate whole tasks through Cowork, the unified workspace, and collect finished, shareable work; on the web or as a desktop app for macOS and Windows
- [About](https://mindshub.ai/about): mission, the MindsDB → MindsHub rebrand, leadership, investors
- [MindsHub vs MindsDB](https://mindshub.ai/mindshub-vs-mindsdb): the rebrand, explained
- [MindsDB Query Engine](https://mindshub.ai/mindsdb-query-engine): the standalone open-source SQL query engine from the MindsDB team — 200+ data sources, Knowledge Bases, Jobs &amp; Triggers
- [Use cases](https://mindshub.ai/use-cases): a gallery of concrete handoffs across teams
- [Consultation](https://mindshub.ai/consultation): free weekly consultation with the MindsHub team — bring a use case, leave with a working agent
- [Pricing](https://mindshub.ai/pricing): plans, model router, and pricing FAQ
- [Model Router](https://mindshub.ai/model-router): swap any model — cost-effective open-source models to control spend, frontier on demand; pre-wired, no API keys, history and memory preserved
- [Careers](https://mindshub.ai/careers): how we work, benefits, and how to get in touch about roles
- [Contact](https://mindshub.ai/contact): talk to the team — demos, pricing, support, partnerships
- [Press Kit](https://mindshub.ai/press-kit): logos, color palette, typography, voice, and boilerplate for press, partners, and brand-permission requests

## Agents

- [Agents](https://mindshub.ai/agents): the open-source agents you can run on MindsHub
- [OpenClaw](https://mindshub.ai/agents/openclaw): the open-source workhorse agent
- [OpenClaw + GBrain](https://mindshub.ai/agents/openclaw-gbrain): OpenClaw with a persistent memory layer
- [NanoClaw](https://mindshub.ai/agents/nanoclaw): lightweight agent for fast handoffs
- [Anton](https://mindshub.ai/agents/anton): the open-source AI coworker that delivers finished work
- [Hermes](https://mindshub.ai/agents/hermes): the open-source orchestration agent
